title: problem_modeling.reinterpret_requested (v1)
description: Entry action of the ReinterpretingSpec state (state machine V1.10): ResearchOrchestrator instructs ProblemModelingAgent to reinterpret the frozen ResearchSpec in light of the literature / field-trajectory research. Emitted immediately after DeepResearching -> ReinterpretingSpec on literature.brief_ready. Payload is intentionally minimal: the ResearchSpec and both briefs are read from the Research Store by ref rather than from this payload. No consumer is wired in M2 (ProblemModelingAgent's ReinterpretingSpec mode is deferred); the loop pauses here.

research_spec_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen ResearchSpec object.

literature_brief_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen LiteratureBrief object.

field_trajectory_brief_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen FieldTrajectoryBrief object.
